text:
sam (Recruiter): Hey @maya, quick one — we have two contract interviewers joining interviews next week. Can we get temporary scorecard + prep-pack access for them? They need access only for panels on 2026-04-02 and 2026-04-03.

maya (People Ops): Sure. Do you have their emails and what TTL you want? Suggested default is 7 days, but we can do 30 for overlap. Also need to confirm they sign the contractor NDA. :white_check_mark:

sam (Recruiter): Emails: contractor.alpha@example.com, contractor.beta@example.com. NDA is signed (uploaded to GH under /contracts/alpha_beta). Can we set expiry 2026-04-06 (4 days after last panel)?

trish (Hiring Manager): Want them in the same interviewer rubric group so their scorecards show up in panel summary. Also please add them to interviewer training cohort A (the short refresher).

maya (People Ops): Got it — I can raise the access ticket. Two things: 1) role will be interviewer-temp with limited perms (view scorecards, submit evals, access prep-pack). 2) we need audit logging enabled for these accounts for the TTL period.

leo (Security): Audit logging yes. Also require SSO + 2FA and restrict download/export on their scorecards. Can we gate downloads?

jin (Platform Eng): We can create a time-bound role in the auth service and attach a policy that disables CSV/print/export. Quick command we use (internal admin CLI):

```
rbac grant --user contractor.alpha@example.com --role interviewer-temp --expires 2026-04-06 --notes "contractor panel access"
rbac grant --user contractor.beta@example.com --role interviewer-temp --expires 2026-04-06 --notes "contractor panel access"
```

That sets expiry and writes to audit logs. Access-bot will post when grants are complete.

leo (Security): Also add a manual review step: security will spot-check 10% of entries during the access window and make sure no PII exports happened.

maya (People Ops): I'll open the ticket now and attach NDA links + panel schedule. Leaving TTL 2026-04-06 per Sam. Will also add training cohort invite for them.

access-bot: rbac grants queued. ETA ~10m. Ticket #HR-4521 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-4521

sam (Recruiter): Thanks all — can you also confirm they get the interviewer prep-pack link and the rubrics?

maya (People Ops): Yes — sending prep-pack and rubric links in the ticket. Prep-pack: https://docs.redwood.com/interviewer-prep/condensed and rubric group: "Panel - SaaS Core".

access-bot: Grants applied for contractor.alpha@example.com, contractor.beta@example.com. Audit log entries created.

jin (Platform Eng): Confirmed role created and policies attached. No export perms.

leo (Security): Spot-check logged, nothing suspicious.

maya (People Ops): Done — added to training cohort and set reminders. Closing ticket after 7 days post-expiry to ensure artifacts retained for audit. :lock:

sam (Recruiter): Awesome, thanks y'all. :raised_hands:

trish (Hiring Manager): Appreciated. Please post if anything changes during panels.

maya (People Ops): Will do — marking thread resolved.
